Nia (Support): Escalating: customer 'GlidePath' (tenant glide-pt-9) can't finish onboarding. Provision API returning intermittent 502s; embeddings 429. Trial blocked. Need CS to notify and coordinate.
Theo (CS Lead): Copy. Any quick mitigations?
Nia (Support): We attempted key rotation and temporary slow-retry, but activation still failing. Logs point to provisioner queue saturation.
Alex (Solutions Eng): We can reroute to a low-capacity fallback pool as a temporary workaround. Command (internal): curl -X POST /internal/reroute -d '{"tenant":"glide-pt-9","pool":"fallback-provision","expires_in":14400}'
infra-bot: Infra acknowledged. ETA to drain queue ~40m.
Rina (CSM): This customer was flagged for potential expansion. Please plan a call within 60m. I'll draft a short proactive note offering a credit if activation delayed.
Theo (CS Lead): Approve reroute. Nia, go ahead and apply; include rollback plan. Rina, send the 10m ack and schedule the call. I'll own the postmortem and renewal touch.
Nia (Support): Reroute applied, API returned 200. Monitoring.
Alex (Solutions Eng): Seeing reduced errors, activations slowly succeeding. Will set automatic expiry on reroute.
Rina (CSM): Invite sent for +35m. Customer replied: "Thanks for the rapid response, appreciate the update." Posting ack copy to private notes.
infra-bot: Incident INC-2025-1971 created (P2) and linked to this thread.
Theo (CS Lead): Good work. After resolution, add a brief onboarding note about handling provisioner backlog and include reroute CLI snippet in playbook.
Nia (Support): Closing loop with infra for full fix and rollback once confirmed.
Rina (CSM): Customer confirmed first seat added on call. Will follow-up with an enablement doc and next steps.
